questions.question: Resolve the 184 previously recorded source/runtime field differences from the full original dossier and workbook provenance. Preserve names, printed CR/XP/HP/AC/ability/attack/damage values and distinct sources; justify any proposed change individually as a source correction or NEW authorship. A match to generated runtime data does not confer approval.

For every one of the 162 listed actions, bind melee/ranged classification, reach/range, line and acquisition, occupied-body geometry, target eligibility, delivery type, magical versus intrinsic source, attack/save ability, costs, timings, interruption, damage packets and cleanup. Preserve actual printed values. Mark absent inputs NEW rather than infer ranged or magical effects from an evocative action name.

Specify which listed attacks each of the 42 Multiattack procedures may select, repeat and mix; preserve printed attack count. Resolve eligibility of recharge or save-only abilities, Action/Reaction budgets, target change, interrupt/death and interrupted sequence remainder. Bind all eight recharge actions to initial availability, charge-up telegraph, recharge event, RNG and use/expiry; no hidden extra attacks from a pulse label.

questions.topic: Pressure Wave missing save and effect
questions.question: The full Pact Automaton source supplies DC15, 3d8 force and a described control effect but does not name a save ability or actually define that control effect. Author a finite source-faithful ability, range, success/failure outcomes, motion/condition duration and interruption procedure; distinguish it from its separate Strength-save Containment Pulse.

Resolve Cave Bear Bite, Dimetrodon Tail Sweep and Giant Constrictor Snake Constrict referenced in tactics without listed actions. Preserve the references; return complete proposed mechanics or an explained exact editorial disposition, not a substitute imported stat block.

All119 parsed printed damage averages equal nearest-integer ties-to-even of their exact listed dice means; 38 are half-integer and81 integral. This observed pattern is not an accepted game-wide rounding rule. Decide a dossier-local display policy while preserving every original dice formula and printed average. Actual RNG damage, fractional mitigation and global rounding retain their own accepted contracts.

Define concrete qualifying behaviors and their evidence/observation predicates, nearby geometry, event timing/frequency, tier selection where the printed range spans tiers, temporary-HP stacking/expiry and interruption. Preserve the emotional-loop counter and its encounter significance; no cosmological truth inferred.

Define the source arena/Seal identity, boundary, temporary versus permanent displacement, return event/destination/occupied geometry, Seal invalidation, death and conflict order with current teleportation and Null rules. Preserve the ability without making an unstated universal immunity.

Separate the printed difficult-ground exemption from legal aerial movement, vertical geometry, cover and path acquisition. Bind existing printed movement modes and define only missing behavior; seeking a bypass angle is not permission to ignore cover.

Give each affected creature deterministic food/young/escape predicates and retreat/break-off state transitions. Preserve noncombat solutions and distinguish a Director-authored encounter objective from a new charm or an automatic success.

Define replay identity for movement paths and action sequences, relevant actor history, geometry tolerance, first-time-per-round scope, qualifying observation and reset event. Specify the granted defensive reaction payload, cost, availability, expiry and nonrecursive triggers.

Specify lair/substrate eligibility, source and target acquisition, origin substitution, maximum geometry, which action/use is permitted, budget and frequency, substrate destruction, damage provenance and suppression.
